preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
The target contract must have a non-zero BNB balance.
Liquidity must not have been added yet (_hasLiqBeenAdded must be false).

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `sweepContingency()` function before liquidity is added. This function will transfer the entire BNB balance of the contract to the owner's address, effectively draining all native currency from the contract.
